nodes.label: K7 deferral decision: frame-splitting/frame-assembly not reproducible by a thin shim
nodes.rationale: Two fatal breakage points: (1) uncompressed pixel-data per-frame splitting (readUncompressed produces nested Value=[[ArrayBuffer]] using information-filter geometry) and (2) compressed frame assembly from BOT offsets — both first-class AsyncDicomReader features a 15-verb→4-verb shim would have to reimplement, defeating streaming. Deferred to 1.x with no src changes; all 1422 tests unchanged.
